entities.name: Théodelinde Bourcin-Dubouché
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Théodelinde Bourcin-Dubouché, known commonly as Marie-Thérèse of the Heart of Jesus, was a Roman Catholic French nun, artist, and founder of the Sisters of Adoration in Paris, France. The cause for her canonization has been formally accepted by the Holy See, and thus she has been declared "venerable".
